  -- We start by noting that the points b, c, and d are collinear in the given order.
  have h3 : collinear b c d := h2
  -- We use the properties of the triangle and the given construction to establish the inequalities.
  have h4 : |(b─d)| + |(c─d)| < |(a─b)| + |(a─c)| := by
    -- By the triangle inequality, the sum of the lengths of BD and DC is less than the sum of BA and AC.
    apply Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    apply Nat.lt_succ_of_lt
    linarith [h1]
  -- We also establish that the angle at d is greater than the angle at a.
  have h5 : ∠ b:d:c > ∠ a:b:c := by
    -- Since the lines BD and DC are constructed internally on BC, the angle at d is greater than the angle at a.
    linarith [h1, h2]
  -- Combining the two results, we conclude the theorem.
  exact ⟨h4, h5⟩
